telemetry.event.world_load_times.descrip: It's important for us to understand how long it takes to entrar a mundo, and how aquele changes sobre tempo. For example, when we adicionar novo features or do larger technical changes, we need to see o que impact aquele had on carregar times.

Knowing how jogadores jogar Minecraft (such as Modo de Jogo, client or servidor modded, and Jogo versão) allows us to focus Jogo updates to improve the áreas aquele jogadores care about most.
The Mundo Carregado event is paired com the Mundo Unloaded event to calculate how long the jogar session has lasted.

telemetry.event.world_unloaded.descripti:
Este event is paired com the Mundo Carregado event to calculate how long the mundo session has lasted.
